argument: The work must read as one continuous pigmented skin before it reads as a gesture instrument. The asymmetrical contour, seven embedded seams, layered pressure shadow, and quiet negative ground must carry the image without interface chrome.

With readout, controls, hint, labels, and prose hidden, the blind view must leave v050's relief and v052's vacancy register. It should read as a continuous body that could dry toward a passage, not as a field with hidden cells.

The visitor must cross the skin and settle before release. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the deterministic passage control must offer equivalent meaningful paths; no hover-only action may carry the work.
The accepted event must re-produce every contour node and seam. A local stripe, glow, status, or colour shift cannot substitute for global membrane geometry.
Same-edge, short, and unsettled gestures must remain geometry-neutral. Settling must be a real condition in the engine, not explanatory theatre.
Four pressure crossings must compound in one drying state. Lift must reconstruct the exact preceding membrane and release must return to the deterministic quiet skin.

Generated p5.js Canvas 2D contour, seam paths, pressure shadows, and layered pigment are the medium. No screenshot, imported illustration, external font, or decorative brush simulator may carry the work.

p5.brush is translated from material production rules into global membrane re-production. Brush presets, watercolor, hatching, grain, palette, composition, source code, examples, and API surface are refused.
v053 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal memory, and viewer task: a continuous skin and edge-to-edge settled crossing replace the recent relief, ring, and vacancy grammars.

Delete v053 if global contour/seam movement is absent, if pressure settling is cosmetic, if order is cosmetic, if lift is inexact, or if the blind membrane reads as a decorated field rather than a new material body.
